faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIAHL Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the AIAHL Medical Officer recruitment is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI). Additionally, a minimum of 20 years of experience, including at least 3 years in medical claims scrutiny and settlement, is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 62 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer position will receive a salary of Rs. 1,20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Officer post in AI Assets Holding Limited.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer position will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of AI Assets Holding Limited, which is www.aiahl.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Medical Officer position is Contractual.
